purpose: Test fresh multi-year cross-sectional momentum and short-term reversal in US sector ETFs, separate from prior intraday ETF/equity experiments.

data.universe_rationale: Fixed eleven SPDR US sector ETFs to test broad sector-relative effects without post-result name substitution.
data.missing_rule: A portfolio signal is eligible only when all eleven ETFs have the required lookback close and all selected legs have exact entry/exit opens.

portfolio.construction: Equal gross weights: long three and short three; 50% long / 50% short; gross exposure 1.0, net exposure 0.
portfolio.return: arithmetic signed open-to-open return in bps, then subtract round-trip cost once per leg

SECTOR_XS_H1_MOM63_HOLD21.feature: trailing 63-valid-session close-to-close return ending at signal close
SECTOR_XS_H1_MOM63_HOLD21.ranking: ascending feature across eleven ETFs; ticker ascending breaks exact ties
SECTOR_XS_H1_MOM63_HOLD21.position: long top three, short bottom three
SECTOR_XS_H1_MOM63_HOLD21.sampling: sequential non-overlapping portfolio observations; after an exit, next signal is that exit session close
